bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to commerce; setting payment term to 45 days for certain corporations; proposing coding for new law in Minnesota Statutes, chapter 325E.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1.

[325E.251] REMITTANCE OF PAYMENT.

(a) If a corporation's stock is a federal covered security, as specified in United States Code, title 15, section 77r(b), the corporation must remit payment for goods and services within 45 days of receiving the goods or services.

(b) For purposes of this section, "corporation" includes a subsidiary that is wholly owned by a corporation subject to paragraph (a).
additions: (a) If a corporation's stock is a federal covered security, as specified in United States Code, title 15, section 77r(b), the corporation must remit payment for goods and services within 45 days of receiving the goods or services.
(b) For purposes of this section, "corporation" includes a subsidiary that is wholly owned by a corporation subject to paragraph (a).
